outputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: true OPENGL tangent-space NORMAL MAP of the supplied worn bridge oak HEIGHT. Input1 HEIGHT is authoritative relief; Input2 ALBEDO is only the exact corresponding feature-layout reference. Create ONE flat 1254x1254 pixel square normal map with the identical crop, pixel coordinates, check/grain layout and matching edge relationships. No rescaling, rotation, translation, feature addition/removal or repainting. Mathematically derive BOTH red and green channels from height gradients, not from blue-tinted emboss or baked lighting: N=normalize((-dH/du,+dH/d(imageVdown),1)); encode RGB=(128+127*Nx,128+127*Ny,128+127*Nz), flat=(128,128,255). ImageU increases RIGHT, imageVdown increases DOWN; OpenGL tangentY points UP. Thus height increasing to the RIGHT lowers R below128; height increasing DOWN raises G above128. Concave narrow checks remain depressions; brown pigment stains do not become relief. Restrained shallow wood fibres and gentle worn ridges, not exaggerated bark ridges. Most broad smooth worn ridges should remain close to neutral blue-violet with limited colored transitions on relief, no global red/green tint drift. No directional lighting, shadows, highlights, albedo coloration, grayscale height/AO rendering, border or text. Exact pixel registration to source, one edge-to-edge tangent normal MAP only, no scene/sphere/multimap sheet.
reference_roles: HEIGHT first: authoritative physical relief and gradient geometry.
ALBEDO second: exact matching feature positions; pigment is not slope.
